name: ranger
_comment: Scout. Light and mobile — a sleeveless tunic over teal travelling pants and brown shoes, messy brown hair, no armour to slow the run/jump/climb poses. Every layer covers the full animation set including combat_idle. Assemble bases are relative to the charset 'remote'.

layers._recolor_note: messy2 ships only the colorless master sheet, drawn in the generator's 'orange' reference ramp; remap it to the 'chestnut' brown ramp to keep the ranger brown-haired.
